events.name: Bash
events.head: Check main vs origin, read the build script, list worktrees
events.input: $ git fetch origin -q 2>&1 | tail -2; git rev-parse --short HEAD origin/main; git merge-base --is-ancestor 7b5f59e origin/main && echo "7b5f59e in origin/main"; git status -sb | head -3; cat -n cloud/scripts/build.sh | head -70; git worktree list | head -20

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read the two deploy memory notes and check for a publish hold
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/.claude/projects/-Users-adithyamurali-tantra-redesign/memory && sed -n 1,40p centre-deploy-clean-worktree.md; echo ----; sed -n 1,30p mirror-export-clean-worktree.md; echo; grep -n "publish held" /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Create a clean worktree at origin/main and clone node_modules into it
events.input: $ O=$(git rev-parse origin/main) && echo "origin/main ${O:0:8}" && git log --oneline 7b5f59e..origin/main | wc -l && rm -rf /private/tmp/t263-wt 2>/dev/null; git worktree prune; git worktree add --detach /private/tmp/t263-wt "$O" 2>&1 | tail -1 && cp -Rc app/node_modules /private/tmp/t263-wt/app/node_modules && cp -Rc cloud/node_modules /private/tmp/t263-wt/cloud/node_modules && ls /private/tmp/t263-wt/app/node_modules | wc -l && ls -la app/.env.local 2>/dev/null | wc -l; grep -n "env.local\|\.env" app/scripts/export-static.sh | head -8; cat cloud/wrangler.toml 2>/dev/null | head -12; ls cloud
